_comment: Template for <set-dir>/collation.json, the Play Booster model scripts/sealed_sim.py
samples from. Copy it, delete the _comment keys, and fill every slot from the
verbatim slot text in WotC's 'Collecting <set>' article.
Rules that cost us accuracy before:
- Sum every treatment of the same card class inside one slot: non-foil + foil +
showcase. A foil dual is still a dual. Counting only the non-foil duals put the
Reality Fracture dual rate at 43.6% instead of 54.5% (DEC-925).
- Booster-fun variants of rares and mythics are still rares and mythics. Fold them
in with __other__ + other_goes_to: proportional.
- Off-set cards (Special Guests, The List) are not in the Sealed pool unless the
event rules say otherwise. State the assumption in the slot note.
- Cross-check against a machine-readable model when one exists (taw/magic-search-engine,
data/boosters/<code>-play.yaml) and record every disagreement in the note.
- Weights per slot need not sum to 1; the simulator normalizes and reports the
residual it absorbed. Say so in the note when the published figures do not sum to 1.
Slot kinds the simulator supports:
- single: draw one card from the groups in `weights`.
- echoed_pair: draw a pair of cards that are printed as a linked pair. Needs a
pairs file passed to sealed_sim.py with --pairs.
A slot kind the set needs and the simulator does not have is an engineer leg:
spec it as a new `kind` here with its own test.
description: Where the weights come from, with dates. Name every source and note where two sources disagree.

groups._comment: One line per group naming exactly which cards are in it, including what is excluded. The simulator resolves group names against the card dump.
groups.main_common: rarity=common in the main numbering, excluding the dual lands and basics
groups.dual_common_land: the common dual land cycle, if the set has one

slots.note: common. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares of the same card class before writing a weight.

common 98.2% / off-set card 1.8%. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares. __other__ is the share this model cannot place; other_goes_to says where it goes ('proportional' spreads it over the named groups).
uncommon. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares.
a linked pair filling two slots; needs --pairs. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares. Delete this slot when the set has no paired cycle.
rare or mythic. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares; booster-fun rares and mythics belong here, not in a separate group.
land slot. NOTE: sum non-foil + foil + showcase shares of the duals. __basic__ is a basic land; the simulator drops basics from the pool because the event supplies them.

promo.note: The date-stamped promo card. Confirm the pool with the board from an actual pack; set enabled=false to simulate without it.

sanity_targets._comment: Per-pack expectation worked out by hand from the article, before running the sim. The sim's test pins the model to these.
sanity_targets.source: who computed these, from which article, on which date
sanity_targets.known_divergence: Any target the model cannot hit, and why. Leave empty when there is none.
